title: Evaluating Fairness in Argument Retrieval
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. It measured the fairness of argument retrieval systems in presenting different stances (PRO vs. CON) on controversial topics.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on evaluating fairness in argument retrieval systems for general controversial topics.
